recommendation.recommendation: Apply nitrogen fertilizer and organic compost to address low nitrogen and organic carbon levels.

Applying nitrogen fertilizer will directly address the nitrogen deficiency, while adding organic compost will improve soil fertility, water-holding capacity, and long-term sustainability. These actions align with the crop's requirements and the current favorable weather conditions.
actions: Apply nitrogen fertilizer at a rate of 50-60 kg/ha to boost nitrogen levels.
Apply 10-15 tonnes of well-decomposed organic compost per hectare to enhance organic carbon content.
Monitor soil health and adjust nutrient application based on periodic soil testing.
